info.name: BodyTrace RPM Data Alerts Data Messages API

params.name: imei
params.description: The device IMEI (serial). BodyTrace documents this as the IMEI without leading zeros and without the final check digit.

params.name: from
params.description: Start of the time window, epoch milliseconds (UTC).

params.name: to
params.description: End of the time window, epoch milliseconds (UTC).

params.name: limit
params.description: Maximum number of messages to return.

items.docs: Retrieve the raw, per-transmission messages a device has sent over the cellular network for a given IMEI and time range. Each message mirrors the payload BodyTrace devices emit (deviceId, ts, batteryVoltage, rssi, and a values object). MODELED - the message payload shape is confirmed from BodyTrace's documented device messages, but this read/query surface is gated behind partner credentials; verify path and parameters against your onboarding docs.
